title: The Pullman house, from its 1890s photograph
items: George M. Pullman's house at Prairie Avenue and 18th Street is no longer a plain draft block: it stands in brownstone, two tall storeys under a slate mansard with dormers and iron cresting, at the heights a Detroit Publishing photograph of the 1890s shows.
A columned portico with a balcony over it fronts Prairie Avenue, a low stone wall runs along the street, and the stable and ranges behind the house still stand.
